articles.title: Netanyahu Erupts At Mamdani: ‘Tormenting His Own Voters’ As NYC Mayor Calls For ICC Arrest
articles.description: Benjamin Netanyahu has accused New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani of “tormenting his own voters” as their confrontation over Gaza and the ICC arrest warrant against the Israeli prime minister intensifies. Mamdani has declared Netanyahu unwelcome in New York, described him as a war criminal and urged the US federal government to act on the warrant. After a legal review, however, the mayor acknowledged that New York City lacks independent authority to arrest Netanyahu. The Israeli leader responded by accusing Mamdani of condemning Israel while excusing Hamas and Iran—allegations the mayor denies. The ICC issued warrants for Netanyahu and former defence minister Yoav Gallant in 2024 over alleged war crimes and crimes against humanity in Gaza. Israel rejects the charges, while Donald Trump has promised Netanyahu will not be arrested anywhere in the United States. Watch.

articles.description: New satellite imagery reportedly shows Iran has begun repair work at nuclear facilities damaged during recent U.S. strikes, fueling fresh debate over the long-term impact of the attacks. According to Fox News, reconstruction activity has been detected at several previously targeted sites. Former U.S. Defense Secretary Mark Esper said Tehran has rapidly restored parts of its missile and drone programs, warning that Iran is steadily rebuilding military capabilities that could strengthen its position in any future confrontation. Esper argued that the strikes did not permanently cripple Iran's strategic infrastructure and called for tougher economic sanctions to slow Tehran's recovery.

articles.title: Pro‐Saudi militias launch major attack on Houthis in Marib & Al‐Jawf
articles.description: Heavy fighting has erupted in northern Yemen as clashes intensified between Houthi fighters and Saudi-backed forces across Al-Jawf and Marib provinces. According to Press TV and Yemen TV, airstrikes targeted Houthi reinforcements, missile launchers, Katyusha rocket sites, and weapons depots in several frontline districts, including Al-Jubah, Al-Safra, and Majzar. Reports also claimed that several Houthi fighters, including missile specialists, were killed during the latest operations. The escalation follows recent Houthi threats to target Saudi-linked commercial shipping in the Red Sea and enforce a maritime ban near the Bab al-Mandab Strait, raising fresh concerns over regional security.

articles.title: Unidentified Drone Crashes Near Ben Gvir's Home; Israeli Security Launches Urgent Probe
articles.description: Israeli authorities are investigating after an unidentified drone crashed near the home of National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir in Kiryat Arba, near Hebron. Officials confirmed that Ben Gvir and his family were unharmed, while the circumstances surrounding the incident remain under investigation. The development comes just days after prosecutors charged a suspect over an alleged plot to target the minister using an explosive drone or guided missile. Israeli security agencies have previously disclosed multiple alleged drone-related threats against Ben Gvir, making the latest incident a significant security concern as investigators work to determine the drone's origin and purpose.
